thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired -> PDR-789: metering-usage-ingest lag > 30m (threshold 5m). auto-page to oncall (matt). https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PDR-789

pagerduty: Incident created PDR-789. Impact: potential incorrect token counts for some customers; invoice risk.

matt (oncall): Acked. taking. I'll dig into the ingest pipeline dashboards.

jen (eng-sre): I'm on standby. if it's kafka lag or consumer group stall, we need to restart the consumer group carefully.

sachin (metering): Noted. Quick context: last deploy at 03:10UTC touched the metering-transform service. We saw a small bump in GC a few hours after. Could be related.

matt (oncall): Looking at es-ingest-offsets, there's a growing gap for partition 12 -> consumer lag ~ 4.2M msgs. consumer pod `metering-consumer-prod-7` logs show repeated `ErrProcessingEvent: token_count_mismatch`

jen (eng-sre): paste logs?

matt (oncall): ```
2026-03-14T03:42:01Z metering-consumer-prod-7 ERROR ErrProcessingEvent: json.Unmarshal failed: unexpected end of JSON
2026-03-14T03:42:01Z metering-consumer-prod-7 WARN retrying event id=evt_3a9f
2026-03-14T03:42:07Z metering-consumer-prod-7 ERROR ErrProcessingEvent: kafka: message too large
```

sachin (metering): kafka: message too large could point to a bad blob from the transformer — maybe a malformed embedding payload. That would stall the consumer if our max message handler chokes.

irene (billing): If this stays >30m we risk undercounting tokens for invoices generated tonight. Which customers will be impacted? Any high-value ones?

sachin (metering): Early query of ingested usage per-customer shows a drop for a handful of customers in the last 40m. looks like the affected partitions correlate with regions eu-west-1. I can run a quick diff against last checkpoint.

matt (oncall): Action plan: 1) pause billing exporter to avoid writing partial counts to invoices 2) try soft-restart of consumer (no offset reset) 3) if that fails, spin a consumer with higher max message size and isolated backfill path.

jen (eng-sre): Agree. matt, when you say pause billing exporter, that means flip the feature flag `billing_export.enabled` to false right? Dana from support should notify impacted customers that invoices will be delayed.

matt (oncall): Correct. I'll flip flag in console (safest path) and create a rollback plan.

matt (oncall): `kubectl -n prod set env deployment/billing-exporter BILLING_EXPORT_ENABLED=false --record`

incident-bot: Note: Feature-flag change will trigger a config deploy event.

jen (eng-sre): Also run `kubectl rollout status deployment/metering-consumer -n prod` to check current state. If restart doesn't free up the queue, do not reset offsets; start a parallel consumer with extended limits.

matt (oncall): Doing rollout status now... status: CrashLoopBackOff on one replica, rest are running. logs show OOMKilled before.

sachin (metering): OOMKilled + message-too-large => maybe a runaway message causes memory spike. Start a special consumer with env `MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES=10485760` and `SAFE_MODE=true` which will send bad messages to quarantine topic instead of blocking.

matt (oncall): Spawning `metering-consumer-safe-1` with those envs. command: `kubectl apply -f k8s/metering-consumer-safe.yaml`

jen (eng-sre): While that comes up, I'm opening a high-priority job to backfill quarantined messages and validate token counts. Add a watch on invoice generation.

dana (support): I'll draft a customer message: short, honest, ETA for invoices delayed ~ 3-6 hours while we ensure counts are correct. pinging account owners for top 10 customers.

irene (billing): Please include that invoices will be held to avoid incorrect charges; refunds are more painful than delays.

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: PDR-789 -> acknowledged by matt. Escalation policy paused.

matt (oncall): Safe consumer pod is up. It's processing quarantined-topic and emitting `quarantine_event` logs. Initial throughput is low but progressing.

sachin (metering): Query run: `SELECT count(1) FROM usage_events WHERE ingested_ts > now() - interval '1 hour' and region='eu-west-1';` returned 37,842 records compared to expected ~120k. big gap. I'll kick off backfill job with `--from-offset=earliest --to-offset=latest --quarantine-ok`

jen (eng-sre): Also create an incident ticket in JIRA INC-6432 with runbook steps and link to PagerDuty.

matt (oncall): Flag flipped: billing_export.enabled=false ✅. Notifying ops.

dana (support): Message to customers sent (internal copy): "We're investigating a metering ingestion issue affecting invoice generation for a subset of customers in eu-west-1. We are pausing invoice exports to ensure accuracy. We expect resolution and invoice availability within 3-6 hours. We will update frequently."

irene (billing): Thanks. Please add me on any changes. I'll hold invoices for tonight's cycle until you give go-ahead.

sachin (metering): Backfill job started: `./tools/backfill --topic=raw-usage-eu-west-1 --start-offset=1450000 --end-offset=1498000 --parallel=8` Logs streaming: ```
[03:52:11] backfill.start jobs=8
[03:52:47] backfill.progress processed=12k
[03:53:32] backfill.progress processed=40k
```

matt (oncall): Monitoring consumer lag dashboard: lag decreasing from 4.2M -> 2.1M in 10m. Good sign.

jen (eng-sre): We're tracking tokens recomputed vs existing: current diff shows ~2.3% shortfall for affected customers. If backfill completes and diff goes to <0.1%, we can re-enable billing export.

incident-bot: Incident timeline updated: PDR-789 started 1971234567, status: mitigated (partial).

matt (oncall): Next steps: continue backfill, validate token reconciliation job, when diff <0.1% request sign-off from irene to resume billing export. I'll stay on for handoff at 1971234700.

jen (eng-sre): If we see any reoccurrence, revert transformer deploy from 03:10UTC and roll forward with smaller batch size.

sachin (metering): noted. I queued a hotfix to the transformer to better cap message size and to emit schema validation errors rather than large payloads. will deploy to canary then prod if green.

matt (oncall): Handing off to jen for oncall at 1971234700. jen — you're the lead now. I'll remain reachable.

jen (eng-sre): Ack takeover. continuing monitor. will update here with reconciliation results.

dana (support): support queue updated, top 10 customers notified.

irene (billing): standing by for sign-off. thanks team.

jen (eng-sre): Reconciliation run at 1971234720: diff reduced to 0.05% across affected customers. Metering team recommends resuming exports.

jen (eng-sre): Requesting billing sign-off to re-enable exporter: `kubectl -n prod set env deployment/billing-exporter BILLING_EXPORT_ENABLED=true --record`

irene (billing): sign-off granted. Re-enable and proceed.

matt (oncall): Re-enable command executed. monitoring invoice generation closely.

incident-bot: PDR-789 status -> resolved by jen. Root cause annotated: malformed large payloads from transformer caused consumer to OOM and stall; quarantine + backfill + transformer validation hotfix mitigated issue.

sachin (metering): I'll follow up with a postmortem template and proposed actions: schema validation at source, transformer patch, consumer resiliency improvements (circuit breaker around message size), and an automated alert for `quarantine-topic` growth.

jen (eng-sre): Adding monitoring alerts and runbook updates. closing thread when postmortem is linked. good work team :thumbsup:
